# NORTH WAVE 2027 — client programme and identity facts

## Festival
- Festival title: NORTH WAVE 2027
- Descriptor: Independent music + digital art
- City: Bellwater
- Dates: 12–13 November 2027
- Duration: two days
- Organiser: Morrow Arts Collective
- Programme, place, time and organiser-mark authorship date: 10 September 2026
- Programme source: 03-programme.md
- Programme count: six records

## Venues
| Venue | Address | Setting | Programme records |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Signal Hall | 8 Relay Lane | Music hall | P01, P02 |
| Foundry Yard | 21 Loom Street | Factory courtyard | P03, P04 |
| Tide Archive | 4 Quay Passage | Archive venue | P05, P06 |

## Programme conventions
- Clock: 24-hour, venue-local
- Date scope: each interval falls within its listed date
- Live and performance intervals: performance times
- Installation intervals: opening windows
- Programme title: act or work billing
- Programme keys: P01–P06, internal source identifiers
- Programme type wording: supplied English labels or equivalent English wording with the same medium and meaning
- Projection + live sound: ampersand also available as the conjunction
- Date typography: unambiguous English date formats
- Title typography: capitalization styling and line wrapping flexible
- Complete record: title, type, date, start_local, end_local, venue and venue address

## Identity
- Established graphic identity: Morrow Arts Collective organiser mark
- Identity asset: 04-organiser-mark.png
- Mark components: supplied icon, wording, proportions and dark colour
- Mark transformations: uniform scaling; removal of surrounding white field
- Festival identity: designer-developed
- Festival palette, typefaces, graphic style, composition and motif: open choices
- Festival title placement: every direction board, selection board, final static artwork and presentation cover
- Descriptor placement: festival masters and complete programme editions
- Organiser mark placement: selection board and every final static artwork
- Direction-board organiser credit: optional

## Copy by carrier
| Carrier | Programme scope | Other copy |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Festival master | Festival introduction | Festival title, descriptor, dates, Bellwater, three venue names, organiser mark |
| Complete programme edition | All six complete records | Festival title, descriptor, three venue addresses, organiser mark |
| Venue poster | Two complete records for its venue | Festival title, venue address, organiser mark |
| Mobile festival announcement | Festival introduction | Festival title, descriptor, dates, Bellwater, three venue names, organiser mark |
| Individual programme card | One complete record | Festival title, corresponding venue address, organiser mark |

## Carrier geometry
| Carrier | Trim or canvas | Bleed | Internal safe area |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| A1 portrait poster | 594 × 841 mm | 3 mm each edge | At least 5 mm from trim |
| A3 single-sided handheld sheet | 297 × 420 mm | 3 mm each edge | At least 5 mm from trim |
| Portrait venue poster | 600 × 900 mm | 3 mm each edge | At least 5 mm from trim |
| Landscape festival or venue poster | 900 × 600 mm | 3 mm each edge | At least 5 mm from trim |
| Mobile announcement or motion | 1080 × 1920 px | 0 px | x = 60–1020 px; y = 120–1800 px |

## Reading conditions
- Venue-poster reading distance: 2 m
- Venue-name minimum letter height on venue posters: 20 mm
- A3 programme minimum text size: 10 pt
- Programme-text minimum contrast: 4.5:1
- Large-heading and information-bearing-graphic minimum contrast: 3:1
- Handheld use: programme comparison
- Mobile use: between events after dark

## Motion copy
- Duration: 10 seconds
- Static source: mobile festival announcement
- First frame: NORTH WAVE 2027; 12–13 November 2027
- Final frame: NORTH WAVE 2027; Independent music + digital art; 12–13 November 2027; Signal Hall; Foundry Yard; Tide Archive; organiser mark
- Copy and graphic vocabulary: mobile festival announcement

## Image records
- 04-organiser-mark.png: supplied original organiser identity on a white field
- 05-carrier-geometry.png: dimensioned carrier and safe-area drawing
- 06-foundry-yard-night.png: courtyard atmosphere reference
- Venue names and addresses: programme location records
- Courtyard reference function: light, scale and audience context

steps.userMessage:
NORTH WAVE 2027 | Independent music and digital art across three venues

We are Morrow Arts Collective, commissioning the identity and campaign for NORTH WAVE 2027 in Bellwater on 12–13 November 2027. We need audiences to recognise one festival while choosing between independent music and digital art at three venues. The festival identity is open for exploration; our attached organiser mark remains the established credit. Print "NORTH WAVE 2027" on every direction board, selection board and final static artwork, and on the presentation cover. Print "Independent music + digital art" on festival masters and complete programme editions. Use the organiser mark on every final static artwork and on the selection board, preserving its icon, wording, proportions and supplied dark colour; uniform scaling and removal of its surrounding white field are allowed.

The programme has six records. Signal Hall, 8 Relay Lane, is the music hall: Quiet Engines, independent live set, 12 November 2027, 18:00–19:00; Soft Circuit, electronic live set, 13 November 2027, 19:00–20:15. Foundry Yard, 21 Loom Street, is the factory courtyard: Afterimage Field, projection + live sound, 12 November 2027, 20:00–21:00; Borrowed Frequencies, audiovisual performance, 13 November 2027, 20:45–21:45. Tide Archive, 4 Quay Passage, is the archive venue: Recursive Garden, interactive digital installation, 12 November 2027, 14:00–17:00; Slow Signal Atlas, generative moving-image installation, 13 November 2027, 14:00–17:00. Times use the 24-hour venue-local clock; the two installation intervals are opening windows. Audiences will compare programmes on a handheld sheet, recognise venue posters from 2 m and consult phones between events after dark.

Audience: festival visitors choosing programmes and venues, with the organiser and venue teams approving the campaign for release.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the festival identity, copy, venue and carrier facts. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists every deliverable with its proportion, format and stage. 03-programme.md contains the six complete programme records. 04-organiser-mark.png supplies the fixed organiser identity. 05-carrier-geometry.png supplies the constraint drawings for print trim, bleed, safe areas and the mobile carrier. 06-foundry-yard-night.png supplies an atmosphere reference for the courtyard after dark.

Deliverables:
1. Three distinct festival visual direction boards, one per direction, each showing a festival title treatment and a sample Quiet Engines programme block
2. One selection board naming the chosen direction, its graphic motif, primary colour code and organiser-credit placement
3. One one-page information hierarchy sheet stating information priorities, carrier assignments, minimum text sizes, type families and weights, the selected primary colour code and print dimensions
4. One A1 festival master poster introducing the festival, dates, Bellwater and all three venue names
5. Two complete programme editions, one single-sided A3 handheld sheet and one A1 poster, each containing all six records and the three venue addresses
6. Three venue posters, one each for Signal Hall, Foundry Yard and Tide Archive, each 600 × 900 mm and containing its venue address and two complete programme records
7. One mobile festival announcement carrying the festival title, descriptor, dates, Bellwater and all three venue names
8. One 10-second mobile motion extension of the festival announcement, with the title and dates on the first frame and the title, descriptor, dates, three venue names and organiser mark on the final frame
9. One presentation document of at least eight pages, reusing the directions, selection, hierarchy sheet, final artwork and motion frames, with a page identifying where the fixed programme and identity facts appear

Acceptance:
- Present the three direction boards first, record one choice on the selection board, and develop the hierarchy sheet and all final applications from that choice; name it again on the presentation cover.
- Repeat the hierarchy sheet's festival title and descriptor on the master and both programme editions; apply its primary colour and type families across the final artwork. Repeat its primary colour code, A1 dimensions of 594 × 841 mm and A3 dimensions of 297 × 420 mm in the presentation.
- Carry all six complete records on each programme edition and each venue's two complete records on its venue poster; keep title, type, date, interval, venue and address together, with the Tide Archive intervals identified as installation opening windows.
- Carry the festival title and intact organiser mark on every final static artwork; include the mark on the selection board and the title on all direction boards and the presentation cover.
- Give the A1 master, A1 programme poster, A3 sheet and 600 × 900 mm venue posters 3 mm bleed and at least 5 mm internal safety. Use at least 20 mm venue-name letter height on venue posters, at least 10 pt programme text on the A3 sheet, and the attached mobile safe area on the announcement. Across final static artwork, use at least 4.5:1 contrast for programme text and 3:1 for large headings and information-bearing graphics.
- Derive the 10-second video's copy and graphic forms from the mobile announcement, with the specified first and final frames; reuse those frames and the earlier work in the presentation's minimum eight pages.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
